decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed adverts are of a size, scale and siting that is in keeping with the site and will not detract form the adjacent conservation area. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.4 (Advertisements) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservations Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003
Condition : 2 - That this consent for a limited period of five years expiring on 26th May 2010.

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.

Condition : 5 - A scheme for the illumination of the adverts shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To avoid glare, which may cause danger and inconvenience to pedestrians, drivers and other users of the highway network.
description: Installation of 2 internally illuminated wall mounted signs, 3 non-illuminated free standing service signs, 2D non-illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 2 - 3D internally illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 1 internally illuminated and 1 non-illuminated wall mounted COSTA signs, one internally illuminated double sided 1D sign, one internally illuminated and one non-illuminated double sided lollipop signs, one non-illuminated single sided free standing road poster sign, internally illuminated single sided wall mounted building sign and one internally and one non-illuminated single sided banner to petrol station.
